title: After 7 years in production, Scarf has reluctantly moved away from Haskell
summary: Scarf, a company that successfully ran Haskell in production for 7 years, has reluctantly decided to migrate away from the language. The article provides insights into the real-world challenges and trade-offs encountered when maintaining a Haskell codebase at scale, including hiring difficulties, tooling limitations, and ecosystem constraints.
problem_solved: Addresses the practical challenges of maintaining a Haskell-based production system over 7 years, including hiring, tooling, and long-term maintainability concerns.
why_valuable: Provides a rare, honest case study of a company that loved Haskell but found it unsustainable for long-term production use, offering valuable lessons for technology stack decisions.
